text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the new year arrived, Almond Eye 
held a press conference, and I watched it 
on television.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye-san, congratulations on winning 
Umamusume of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
A unanimous selection hasn't happened 
since T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I am deeply grateful 
for your praise of my running.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"The Senior Year is finally here. Have you 
decided on your goals for this year?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
For now, the plan is to kick off this 
year's racing campaign in Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Dubai! Which means... you're running in an 
international race!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I am in the middle of making 
preparations for that as well.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Getting advice from Vivlos-san, who has 
experience with the Dubai expedition—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos-san, huh. It's possible I might 
end up running in the same race as her—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It is possible. If so, she will surely 
become our most formidable rival.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
There are other Umamusume gathering here 
who have won GⅠ races across the globe, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I will not lose.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No matter who in the world stands against 
me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I was overwhelmed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even when facing the entire world, Almond 
Eye did not waver in the slightest."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes are fixed straight on the 
strongest in the world...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes... To Nakayama.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'm a little late, but my year doesn't 
truly start until I've seen the Gold 
Cup...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"The key to the year's plan lies in the 
Nakayama Kimpai," as they say, right?
choice_data_list:
Is that so... In that case, maybe I'll go 
too.

Is that so... In that case, maybe I'll go 
too.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes, I think that's a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Finally heading overseas, huh?! "Almond 
Eye Takes Off to the World!" That's 
tomorrow's front page for sure!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Is the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe next 
after Dubai!? This is so exciting~!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Those must be the reporters who came 
for Almond Eye-san's press conference...
choice_data_list: So Chrono was watching too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... After the Japan Cup, we take on the 
world.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: It's only natural, I suppose...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought I might have to race against 
Almond Eye this year, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right now, her back feels so far away.
choice_data_list: Let's win the Triple Tiara too, Chrono!

Let's win the Triple Tiara too, Chrono, 
okay!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huh? The T-Triple Tiara... for me...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Uh, well... I-I've never really thought 
about it before, so...
choice_data_list:
Still, if you win them one by one, you'll 
claim the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Me, becoming a Triple Tiara horse 
girl...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, stop, you actually made my heart 
skip a beat...! Even though it's just 
hypothetical..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
L-Let's hurry and go! The Nakayama Kimpai 
is about to start...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Now then, where should we start? There are 
all kinds of events, but...
choice_data_list:
An event? What kind of things will there 
be?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
There will be talk shows with invited 
guests, raffle events, and things like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, is there anything specific you 
would like to see?
choice_data_list:
Let's try predicting the winner of the 
Gold Cup.
That talk event has me curious...
Test your luck at the raffle!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It will also serve as a good review 
of the Genesis Method.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it ain't Chrono. Did ya come to 
watch the Nakayama Kimpai?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who called out was Tamamo Cross. A 
petite Umamusume with a spirited Naniwa 
soul.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Does that mean you are too, 
Tamamo-san...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, to test my luck! I figured I'd see 
how my year's gonna go based on whether my 
Nakayama Kimpai bet hits.
choice_data_list:
Why with your predictions for the Gold 
Cup?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Gold Cup" just sounds brilliant, doesn't 
it?! Sounds like it's gonna line our 
pockets real good!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"The key to the year's plan lies in the 
Kimpai"! If I nail my predictions, this 
year's financial fortune will be super 
mega blessed~!
choice_data_list: In other words, a test of luck?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, you can't go underestimating a test 
of luck!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Believing in the results of a test 
of luck can occasionally draw in drama. It 
is one of the Genesis Factors, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You really get it, Chrono! Come on, let's 
divine our fortunes for the year together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three of them decided to predict the 
winning Umamusume to divine their fortunes 
for the year. And the result... Chrono 
Genesis hit the bullseye.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Today's guest is... Sakura Laurel-san. Ah, 
it's already started. Let's hurry!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah... I didn't make it in time...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Chrono-chan. Did you come to listen to 
me by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel, ever the dependable and 
positive big sister, quickly spotted me 
and called out.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I just got here a moment ago... So I 
couldn't hear the talk. I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't apologize! There were so many 
events going on, so just choosing to come 
to mine makes me super happy♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. It's a bit embarrassing, but— 
could you at least accept this?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
!! T-The limited-edition clear file from 
attending the talk event...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A photo of Laurel-san's heroic figure the 
moment she won the Nakayama Kimpai...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
While there's plenty of merch from her 
Tenno Sho (Spring) and Arima Kinen 
victories, Nakayama Kimpai merch is rare!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The Nakayama Kimpai is the race where 
Laurel-san earned her first graded win... 
A truly monumental turning point in 
history! Ah, to think of that precious 
moment... ahh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, it's a very important race to me. 
Fufu, that's what I talked about in 
today's interview too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Chrono-chan, would you mind chatting for 
a bit? About my Gold Cup. I'd like you to 
hear about it."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: O-Of course, with pleasure...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we have some sweets while we 
chat?♪ Come, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it seems one can win prizes from the 
fortune slip. Let us go at once.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah, Chrono, 'sup! Perfect timing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's the hot-blooded disciplinary 
committee chairwoman, Bamboo Memory.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You don't happen to have a spare racing 
paper, do ya?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you can't draw a fortune unless 
you have a newspaper. They turned me away 
at the door!
choice_data_list:
I'll give you mine. You've got Chrono's, 
right?

I'll give you mine. You have one too, 
right, Chrono?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Chrono, you've got so many notes 
written all over your newspaper! You're 
even using both a red pen and a pencil!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Since you never know what might 
become a historic event, I make sure to 
write everything down.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Your newspaper would be... a "Needs a bit 
more effort", Trainer, I'd say.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer is... summarizing it on the 
computer.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
She does jot things down in memos 
sometimes, but... I've seen her say, "I 
can't read this later," quite a few 
times...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I guess it really comes down to... "Let's 
try a little harder!"
choice_data_list:
(Maybe I should take up penmanship 
practice this year...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Coincidentally, I found myself harboring a 
New Year's resolution...
